library_preparation_preflight.summary: No extra dependency or Docker image is needed. Spring 2.5.6.SEC03, javassist 3.15.0-GA, Netty 3.2.5.Final and commons-logging all come in transitively and resolve from Maven Central. The `dubbo` protocol, Netty transport and the Hessian2 copy bundled in the jar all run in-process on localhost. Every optional integration (ZooKeeper/zkclient/curator, Redis, Mina, Grizzly, fastjson, CXF, Thrift, Jetty, validation, JCache) is `provided`-scope and only reached through registries or protocols the tests should avoid. Two pieces of test setup are needed: an `--add-opens` JVM argument so javassist 3.15 works on JDK 25, and steering the tests away from code paths that generate classes at runtime, which cannot work in Native Image.
library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance:
1) JVM test task: javassist 3.15.0-GA `ClassPool.toClass` defines classes by calling `java.lang.ClassLoader.defineClass` through reflection with `setAccessible(true)`. On JDK 25 that fails with InaccessibleObjectException unless you add `tasks.withType(Test).configureEach { jvmArgs "--add-opens=java.base/java.lang=ALL-UNNAMED" }`, the same pattern as `tests/src/com.alibaba/fastjson/1.2.83/build.gradle`. Dubbo reaches this from `ClassGenerator`/`Wrapper`/`Proxy`, `JavassistProxyFactory` and the `javassist` adaptive compiler. Don't try to fix it by pinning a newer javassist; that is not this library's setup.
2) Native Image cannot define or compile classes at runtime. Avoid paths that generate bytecode: `ExtensionLoader.getAdaptiveExtension()` for SPI interfaces without a hand-written `@Adaptive` class (Protocol, ProxyFactory, Transporter, Cluster, RegistryFactory and others; `ExtensionFactory`/`AdaptiveExtensionFactory` and `Compiler`/`AdaptiveCompiler` are fine). Also avoid `ServiceConfig`/`ReferenceConfig`, whose static fields create adaptive Protocol/ProxyFactory/Cluster extensions, and `Wrapper.getWrapper`/`com.alibaba.dubbo.common.bytecode.Proxy`. Reach the same code through: `ExtensionLoader.getExtensionLoader(X.class).getExtension("name")` and `getActivateExtension(url, key)`, which read the SPI files under `META-INF/dubbo/internal/`; `getExtension("jdk")` on ProxyFactory (`JdkProxyFactory`, which uses `java.lang.reflect.Proxy` plus reflective invocation); the `injvm` protocol; and the `dubbo` protocol over Netty, with URLs like `dubbo://127.0.0.1:<NetUtils.getAvailablePort()>/<iface>`. Exporting and referring via `DubboProtocol.export`/`refer` with a JdkProxyFactory invoker is fine.
3) Other good targets: `Serialization` extensions (`hessian2`, `java`, `compactedjava`, `dubbo`, `json`) round-tripping real POJOs, which exercises the bundled `com.alibaba.com.caucho.hessian` and Java serialization; `com.alibaba.dubbo.common.json.JSON`; `URL` parsing; `PojoUtils`
...[truncated]
risks: Javassist runtime class generation (adaptive extensions, Wrapper, Proxy) is unsupported in Native Image. Tests that reach `ServiceConfig`/`ReferenceConfig` or the Spring `dubbo:` XML namespace will fail the native run however much metadata is added, so both API-level and Spring-config coverage are limited.

Spring 2.5.6.SEC03 predates the module system. The Dubbo Spring XML namespace path (`DubboNamespaceHandler`, `ServiceBean`/`ReferenceBean`) may break on JDK 25, and it also goes through adaptive extensions, so it is a poor coverage target.

Netty 3.2.5 starts boss/worker thread pools. Tests must close servers and clients (`ExchangeServer.close()`, `Protocol.destroy()`) and use ephemeral localhost ports, or the JVM/native test run can hang or ports can collide.
A shipped `user-code-filter.json` must cover both `com.alibaba.dubbo` and the bundled `com.alibaba.com.caucho.hessian` package, so the Hessian serialization metadata isn't dropped.
